collectedSources.view: historic photo (rainy, deciduous trees leafless), looking down a wide open square with a formal avenue of large mature trees; two-storey white timber building on one perimeter side, red timber buildings on the other; Gästgivaregård visible in the distance
collectedSources.notes: 'Foto: Carlsson, Ulla — Örebro läns museum' watermark — historic archival photo

collectedSources.view: colour postcard-era photo of corner of Torget with a green two-storey timber shop ('BÖCKER PAPPER TOBAK'), mature deciduous trees, red timber buildings visible in the distance, wide paved surface, kiosk with awning

collectedSources.view: historic B&W photo of Torget corner with two-storey timber building ('FRISÖR' hair-salon sign), long avenue of trees running down the length of the square, dirt / gravel surface, buildings receding into distance

collectedSources.view: Google Maps zoomed on Grythyttan centre with labels for 'Grythyttans gästgivaregård', 'Grythyttans kyrka', 'Tempo' and 'Pizzans Hus', and a red POI marker over Torget. Shows the road-net around the square: Prästgatan enters from the east, Skolgatan meets the west end, Hammargatan crosses south of the square, Lokavägen skirts the south side, Kyrkogatan and Nygatan run parallel to the north
collectedSources.notes: Map only — no ground surface, monument, benches, trees or perimeter-facade information.

collectedSources.view: Google Street View wide shot from the Prästgatan/Torget corner (SV address label 'Torget 4') looking north-east across the square; paved/gravel surface, a parked lorry near the corner, one row of perimeter buildings visible along the north edge
collectedSources.notes: Only one side of the square in frame; no central-monument view, no full-perimeter coverage, no tree canopy visible from this angle.
